§3THREE RECIPES IN THIS MOD CARE WHAT GRADE YOUR WATER IS - THE THREE THAT MAKE AN OXIDE.§r
In every one of them the water is not a coolant and not a solvent. It is §1literally the reagent§r: whatever it leaves behind ends up in the fired ceramic, which is why the grade lands on these three steps and on nothing else in the mod.

§512. RECONVERSION§r §8- Chemical Plant t3, IV, 30 s - the URANIUM grade§r
 §2 1,000 L Enriched UF6 + 2,000 L Hydrogen + 2,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG + circuit 1  ->  N x Ceramic UO2 Powder + 4,000 L HF back§r
  §8UF6 + 2 H2O + H2 -> UO2 + 4 HF. Base 4 at Grade 1.§r

§520. TAILS RECONVERSION§r §8- Chemical Plant t3, IV, 18 s - the MOX diluent§r
 §2 2,000 L Depleted UF6 + 4,000 L Hydrogen + 4,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG + circuit 1  ->  N x Depleted UO2 Powder§r
  §8The same reaction on the cascade tails, and the dirty route: no HF comes back. Base 8 at Grade 1.§r

§5§l21. §lTHORIA§r §8- Chemical Dehydrator, IV, 25 s - the THORIUM grade§r
 §2 8x Thorium Oxalate Dust + circuit 1 + 2,000 L of ONE WATER RUNG  ->  N x Thorium Dioxide Powder + 2,000 L Carbon Dioxide§r
  §8The oxalate cake is WASHED before it is fired - which is exactly what the real process does. Base 6 at Grade 1.§r

§5§lTHE §lLADDER§r §8- twenty-seven recipes, nine rungs on each of the three§r
  §8rung                  yield    UO2    MOX    ThO2§r
  §8Distilled Water       x0.5§r   §2 2§r     §2 4§r     §2 3§r     §8~32 Uraninite a rod§r
  §8Grade 1 Purified      x1.0§r   §2 4§r     §2 8§r     §2 6§r    §8 16.0 Uraninite a rod§r
  §8Grade 2               x1.5§r   §2 6§r    §2 12§r     §2 9§r
  §8Grade 3               x2.0§r   §2 8§r    §2 16§r    §2 12§r
  §8Grade 4               x2.5§r  §2 10§r    §2 20§r    §2 15§r     §8~6.4§r
  §8Grade 5               x3.0§r  §2 12§r    §2 24§r    §2 18§r
  §8Grade 6               x3.5§r  §2 14§r    §2 28§r    §2 21§r
  §8Grade 7               x4.0§r  §2 16§r    §2 32§r    §2 24§r
  §9Grade 8 Purified      x4.5§r  §2 18§r    §2 36§r    §2 27§r    §9 3.6 Uraninite a rod§r

§1Grade 1 is the base rung, x1.0.§r §8Distilled water gives half of it; every grade above adds another half.§r

§5WHY ALL THREE OXIDE STEPS§r
MOX is 30 parts tails powder to 2 parts plutonium dioxide, and thorium fuel is 30 parts thoria to 2 parts uranium ceramic, so better water makes every fuel grade cheaper, not just uranium. Across the whole ladder the four fuel grades gain §2x9.00, x7.15, x9.00 and x2.83§r - every one of them well above the §8x1.40§r the same water pays on the reactor.

§5WHAT THAT IS WORTH§r
One §9Extraction Derrick§r digs 6 Uraninite every 200 ticks - 36 a minute,§9 3,240 over a 90-minute decay cycle§r. A full tier-5 silo burns§9 201 rods§r in that time, and 3,240 / 16.0 is 202.5.
§1At Grade 1, one Derrick exactly feeds a fully built tier-5 plant.§r At Grade 8 one Derrick feeds several.

§5AND A SECOND, MUCH SMALLER EFFECT§r
Purified water in the §9reactor's feedwater hatch§r also multiplies the plant's EU: §2+5% a grade, x1.05 at Grade 1 up to x1.40 at Grade 8§r. The panel says so, in the STEAM CHAIN group:
  §9Feedwater: Grade 8 Purified Water - output x1.40§r
  §8(plain and distilled water run this plant at x1.00 - the grade is a bonus, never a requirement)§r

[warn]§cIt has to be a DEDICATED feedwater line.§r The reactor draws its feedwater §9worst-first§r, so a hatch row holding plain water and Grade 8 spends the plain water and pays you nothing. The fuel line does the exact opposite - each oxide step matches the BEST rung you have piped to it.[/warn]

[note]§1Plain water is still enough, permanently.§r Plain and distilled both count as x1.00 on the reactor: the grade is a bonus, never a requirement. No line appears on the panel below Grade 1.[/note]

[note]§1Distilled water is a real rung of the FUEL ladder, not an omission.§r It yields half of Grade 1 on all three steps, and §9every other step in the chain is grade-blind§r - the press, the sinter, the lathe, the Hall and the Assembly Line neither know nor care. So without a Purification Plant you still reach all four fuel grades, at half rate. There is no second gate.[/note]

[warn]§cThe Spiral's coolant hatches are NOT feedwater.§r Grade 8 water is a perfectly good coolant and you may run it there - but the output multiplier is read from the feedwater hatches alone, and coolant will never pay it.[/warn]

[note]A water ladder is a route to §9cheaper fuel§r, never to more power. The whole ladder is worth +40% EU; moving one rung up the FUEL ladder - Uranium to MOX - is worth +100%.[/note]
